# agentpc

agentpc gives AI agents instant, resettable Windows and Ubuntu desktop VMs on an Apple Silicon Mac, through one MCP server (`agentpc mcp`).

## Links

- [Website](https://agentpc.pawanpaudel.com.np/)
- [MCP docs](https://agentpc.pawanpaudel.com.np/mcp.html)
- [CLI docs](https://agentpc.pawanpaudel.com.np/cli.html)
- [Guide](https://agentpc.pawanpaudel.com.np/guide.html)
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/pawanpaudel93/agentpc/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Source](https://github.com/pawanpaudel93/agentpc)
- [Releases](https://github.com/pawanpaudel93/agentpc/releases)

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://agentpc.pawanpaudel.com.np/install.sh | sh
```
